title: SmokeBuddy Original Air Filter
description:
SmokeBuddy Original
The smokebuddy Original, well in this case the vapour buddy. Your very own personal air filter. This handy little device makes your exhaled vapour literally disappear. This includes the smell and the sight of you vapour. It also has the ability to literally make smoke disappear so vapour is an easy job for the smokebuddy. All this happens due to the activated charcoal that is inside your smokebuddy.
To use simply exhale your vapour through your smokebuddy original then re-apply the 2 caps when your finished. It really is that simple.
You can expect to get a good amount of use out of a smokebuddy original but there will come a time when the inside of your smokebuddy gets a bit on the eww side and you may want to replace it at that stage.
The Smokebuddy original is great for around the house but if you need to stick it in your pocket then it is a bit on the bulky side. In which case the smokebuddy junior may be a better option. Click
HERE
to check it out.
Included
1 x SmokeBuddy Original (Black)
